text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day. As usual, an elegant humming 
echoed throughout the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Needless to say, it was Sounds of Earth. 
Watching her wave her finger like a baton, 
following her heart's desire, is always 
heartwarming to see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If you turn a blind eye to the total 
disaster scattered all around the sofa...
choice_data_list: Got a sec, Earth?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reminded Sounds of Earth to clean up the 
places she used—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my amore. Come now, don't make such a 
scary face.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
When the Muse whispers to me, I simply get 
swept away. It's how it always goes!
choice_data_list: Didn't you get scolded at home?
Didn't you get scolded at home?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Not at all! It was just like this, see—

text_block_list.name: Housekeeper
text_block_list.text:
A new song? You're in top form today as 
well. May I clear the items on that table 
over there?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you, signora!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hm? That sound of sweeping—what an 
*agilmente*! I can hear a whole new 
*melodia*!

text_block_list.name: Housekeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! I'm honored. I shall put my all 
into making dinner tonight.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I look forward to it! Until then, I 
shall devote myself to vocal practice as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, me too. Let's do our best together 
for the next concert.

text_block_list.name: Earth Family
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! Ohohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, it seems she relies on 
housekeepers and hasn't done any chores 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every family has their own circumstances, 
and it's not my place to meddle, but...
choice_data_list:
Why don't we try learning it bit by 
bit...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...I see? Well, it's a suggestion from the 
direttore, after all. I'll give it 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...I see? Well, it's a suggestion from the 
direttrice, after all. I'll give it 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, some tidying up. All I need to do 
is put things back where they belong, but—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Hey, take a look, Direttore.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Hey, take a look, Direttrice.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The sheet music flutters atop the 
cushion... A miraculous session playing 
alongside the droplets trickling down the 
glass!
choice_data_list:
Forget that for now! Play the sound of 
order!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is sweeping. If they can just handle 
this, for now...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The drowsy afternoon sunshine— What an 
adagio.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: *Fluff*... *Rustle*...
choice_data_list: Make sure you sweep up the dust properly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No good. Fundamentally, she has zero 
interest in housework. Somehow, I must 
draw out her motivation—
choice_data_list:
Earth, at this rate the room is going to 
cry!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list:
The room is crying because it wants to 
become beautiful!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...That is...
choice_data_list:
Don't you want to turn it into a sound of 
joy...!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I was completely in the wrong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth wore a sorrowful 
expression. ...Phew. Looks like the 
message got through.
choice_data_list:
Alright, from here on out we'll make sure 
to—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì, turning over a new leaf—I present to 
you: 'The Cleaning Song.'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grooming time~~~~♪ Gotta look my best~~~~♪
choice_data_list: Singing!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Me and you, and our little love nest 
too~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a light-footed step, I swept with the 
broom. And to my surprise...! The floor 
turned out properly clean!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let's put everything back the way it 
should be~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a satisfying clack-clack-clack, the 
scattered items neatly settled right back 
into their proper places...!

text_block_list.name: Little Birds
text_block_list.text: Pee-pee-pee-pee-pee-pee~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hello, little birds! Are you here to help 
me out?
choice_data_list: That's... impossible...!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do the laundry while 
we're at it! Come on, let's do it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Sweat and mud and dirt, past scars too~♪ 
All washed clean into purity fit for you 
to wear~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Fluttering in the blue sky, astonishingly 
white♪"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fine!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Thank you, little birds! See you later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The little birds took flight. ...I have no 
idea what happened, but the room had 
become completely spotless.
choice_data_list:
Well, it's all cleaned up now, so I guess 
it's fine...
See, you can do it when you try! Amazing!
See, you can do it when you try! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The little birds took flight. ...I have no 
idea what happened, but the room had 
become completely spotless.
choice_data_list:
Well, it's all cleaned up now, so I guess 
it's fine...
See, you can do it when you try! Amazing!
See, you can do it when you try! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I'll officially add your part too, 
so let's keep going like this from now on!
choice_data_list: Huh!? My part too!?
Huh!? My part too!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It was fun, wasn't it? Come on, can't you? 
Please, I'm asking you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth, an expert at 
sweet-talking others into helping him. 
...His road to household independence 
seems long.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your words have given me fresh 
inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
For now, I've completely spent all my 
energy. Until it builds up again, 
housework is on pause.
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I'll treat you to an even more splendid 
performance next time. Look forward to 
it!"
